title: The return of Polio in the US – B1+ English Listening Test

seo.title: The return of Polio in the US – B1+ English Listening Test - Test-English
seo.description: Listening comprehension practice test for upper-intermediate students (CEFR B1+ level). Health, illnesses. English listening test.

parts:
B1+ English Listening Test

Listen to a short excerpt from a popular radio program called 1A and answer the questions. A1 is produced by WAMU, American University Radio, and distributed by NPR.

Listen to the complete 1A podcast
Questions

questions.prompt: There has been just one case of polio in the area of New York.
Potential victims of polio were people who received ...

choices.html: fewer than three doses of the vaccine.
received the vaccine after he was born.

questions.prompt: The woman who shares her story says that...

choices.html: her parents were emotional when the vaccine appeared.
she and her siblings often went to the swimming pool.

questions.prompt: Polio has reappeared in the US because...

choices.html: Americans in general have insufficient immunity against polio.
Vaccination in New York is much lower than in the rest of the country.
The county of Rockland has a problem with immunization.
